description.value: Red Velvet Cafe is a cozy independent cafe in the heart of Downtown Langley, known for its sourcing of 100% wild-grown, chemical-free Frog Friendly Coffee from Oaxaca, Mexico. The menu features homemade baked goods, fresh-made sandwiches, and breakfast, alongside a curated selection of over 45 certified-organic loose teas from local Langley supplier Naked Teas Galore. The welcoming, community-oriented atmosphere makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

The 'ORDER HERE' button and 'Made Fresh To Order' language hint at takeout capability but do not explicitly confirm it, so Takeout remains null.
